summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (02057) and NYSE-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K comprising four Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 9-14, 2026, disclosing numerous on-market repurchases of American depositary shares (each representing one Class A ordinary share) between August 12 and mid-August 2026 at prices ranging roughly USD 21.22 to USD 23.00 per ADS. Shares are bought but not yet cancelled, leaving outstanding count at 557,330,906. This is a routine buyback disclosure, not a special situation; watch execution pace versus any authorized program and potential cancellation timing.
